subject: No royalty received
description: I published my book 4 months ago and still haven't received any royalty. What's going on?

subject: Royalty amount seems too low
description: My royalty amount seems too low. I sold 200 copies but only received ₹3,000.

subject: Different ISBN on Amazon
description: My book is showing a different ISBN on Amazon than what's on the physical copy.

subject: Terrible print quality
description: I received my author copies and the print quality is terrible. The images are blurry and pages are misaligned.

subject: Book unavailable on Amazon
description: My book is published but it's showing as "Currently Unavailable" on Amazon.

subject: Still in typesetting
description: It's been 3 weeks and my book is still in typesetting. When will it be done?

subject: Update Amazon description
description: Can I update the description of my book on Amazon after it's already live?

subject: Royalty unpaid — legal action
description: I will take legal action if my royalty is not paid by Friday. I have been waiting far too long and nobody is responding.

subject: Duplicate ISBN
description: The ISBN assigned to my book is a duplicate of another author's book. Amazon is mixing up the two listings.

subject: Binding falling apart
description: The binding on three of my author copies is coming apart and pages are falling out.

subject: Not on Flipkart
description: My book shows on Amazon but is not showing on Flipkart at all, even though it should be listed there.

subject: Author bio
description: How do I add my bio and a photo to my author page? I'd like to update it.

subject: Where is my book?
description: Which stage is my book at? I haven't had any update email for two weeks and the cover design is still pending.

subject: Next payout date
description: When will my next royalty payment be credited? The quarter ended last month.

subject: Wrong title on Amazon
description: Amazon shows the wrong title and wrong author name for my book. Please correct the metadata.

subject: Package question
description: Do you offer the Bestseller Breakthrough package? What does it include compared to Standard Free?

subject: Eight months without payment
description: I haven't been paid my royalty for 8 months and nobody replies to my emails. This is fraud and I will go to the police.

subject: Pages missing
description: Several pages are missing from my author copies and some are printed upside down. I need a reprint.

subject: Cover approval
description: Is my cover design waiting for my approval? I have not received the proof yet and want to know the timeline.

subject: Amazon UK listing
description: Is my book available on Amazon UK? I can only see it on Amazon India and Amazon US.

subject: Royalty statement mismatch
description: My royalty statement shows 150 copies sold but my Amazon dashboard says I sold 190. Can you check the calculation?

subject: Thank you
description: Thank you for the quick help last time. Just wanted to say the team is great, no action needed.
